method_note: NBA player SGP builder. Confluence_score >= 5 + OVER signals across PTS/REB/AST/3PM/PRA + 30+ PTS + DD. Naive parlay_p (independent) and correlation_boosted parlay_p (1.15x for same-player positive correlation).
